as_told.title: Ashton Forbes plasma orb wormhole theory of MH370

plain: MH370, a Malaysian airliner that vanished in 2014 in a story CNN covered for three months, is said by a researcher named Ashton Forbes to appear in videos being circled by three glowing orbs over the Nicobar Islands. Forbes, who began posting about it on Twitter, claims the orbs were man-made, fusion-powered plasma that opened a spinning wormhole and teleported the plane westward out of the sky. Michels tells this himself in several episodes, repeating Forbes's claim, which would mean secret human technology far beyond anything known.
